submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile-type InSbO4-like phase everywhere on the line. There is an In2O3-like secondary phase on the In-rich side (peaks at Q≈2.14, 2.48, 3.50, 4.11), and it gets weaker as Sb increases. Near In0.17 a weak new peak (Q≈2.10) appears. EQE rose steadily with Sb content: idx5 0.0106%, idx18 0.0176%, idx25 0.0226%. Index 25 (In0.20Sb0.80) was the highest measured.

rejected.reason: In-rich, mixed with In2O3-like phase; lowest EQE (0.0106%)
